subject: Proposed City Charter Amendments
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to review proposed targeted amendments to the city charter regarding council oversight, the budget process, council staffing, and board confirmations. The committee voted to report the paper out favorably and place the proposed amendment language on the April 25 regular council meeting agenda.

items.title: Proposed amendments to the city charter
items.summary: Vice President Bears presented three targeted charter amendments to give the council power to amend the city budget without exceeding the mayor's total, authorize the council to hire staff and legal counsel, and require council confirmation of mayoral appointments to boards and commissions. The committee voted to report the paper out favorably and place the language on the April 25 council agenda.
